verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS issuing platform, but the evidence shows no self-hosted or on-prem deployment of Adyen Issuing. The docs describe a hosted service run through Adyen's Customer Area and APIs, backed by Adyen's banking licenses. Receiving relayed authorisation webhooks on your own servers is an adjacent integration feature, not self-hosting of the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
